title: Outlook: Copilot summaries at the top of search results, with a link into Copilot chat
summary: Hold: the briefing extends the documented Copilot Chat app controls to Copilot in Outlook as a whole without evidence for that wider scope. It also infers the summary's mailbox grounding, the effect of licence tiers on its data reach, and the presence of mail citations from sources that do not describe those details.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps blocks it in the Copilot app, Teams, Outlook and Copilot Chat on the web.
claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.
claims.fix: Attribute this scope to Manage Copilot Chat and add: 'The general Integrated Apps reference says app blocking affects Outlook and the Microsoft Copilot application, while Teams continues to use Teams admin center settings.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/teams-apps-work-on-outlook-and-m365 alongside https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-copilot-chat.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps Copilot block includes users assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: If you block the Copilot app using the Integrated app control, you block the Copilot app tenant-wide across the Microsoft Copilot app, Outlook, and the web, including for users assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: Blocking an app overrides previous admin deployments and user installations for everyone in the organisation.
claims.quote: Blocking an app overrides any previous admin deployment or user installation in Microsoft 365 and Outlook so that no one in your organization can use the app.

claims.claim: The specific-users availability option controls which users can self-install and use the app.
claims.quote: Specific users/group in the organization can install means that only the users selected by you are able to install the app on their own from the store and use it in the client. Unselected users are not able to do so.
